messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['HSBC is carrying out a scheduled software upgrade to improve the quality of our online services to customers so that they can do a lot more within there online account.', 'Your order #2788-11262 accepted.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', ':::ICT HELP DESK', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
